items.title: The associated graded of a zeta-stable module is a direct sum of simple modules when the module is stable for a generic parameter
items.author: Hiraku Nakajima
items.source_version: Official SIGMA 5 (2009) article 003, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2009.003; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the structural lemma on the associated graded object of a module stable for a generic parameter (author Lemma at source lines 1921-1936, label lem:bulletstable). Its proof (source lines 1963-2026) is the longest of the author's explicitly headed proofs in that section of the paper: it runs through the face structure of the stability parameters and the Jordan-Holder filtration of a polystable module and uses the author's earlier surjectivity criterion for the maps beta_i together with the author's criterion for the non-vanishing of the regular part to identify which simple modules may appear in the graded object. The statement is one of the two inputs that the author's branching theorem needs about the strata, which is why its proof is written out in full. H2.
